identificationSites.name: Camp George West Military Training Complex
identificationSites.category: Military Camp / Training Complex / Historic District
overview: Camp George West is a documented military training complex near Golden with a surviving historic campus and major National Guard-era training resources.

identificationSites.name: Denver Ordnance Plant / Denver Federal Center WWII Industrial Complex
identificationSites.category: WWII Ordnance Plant / Federal Industrial Complex
overview: The Denver Federal Center preserves the campus identity of the World War II Denver Ordnance Plant, a major military-industrial manufacturing complex.

identificationSites.name: Glenn L. Martin Titan Missile Test Facilities / Air Force Plant PJKS
identificationSites.category: Cold War Missile Test / Military-Industrial Complex
overview: Air Force Plant PJKS in the Waterton area was a Cold War missile-test complex associated with Glenn L. Martin and Titan development, with documented test-facility remnants.

identificationSites.name: Leyden Coal Mine, Company Town & Railroad Complex
identificationSites.category: Coal Mine / Company Town / Railroad Complex
overview: Leyden was a coal-mining complex with a company town and railroad connection; surviving camp fabric identifies the broader industrial landscape.

identificationSites.name: Lookout Mountain Lariat Trail & Denver Mountain Parks Road Complex
identificationSites.category: Historic Scenic Road / Park Infrastructure Complex
overview: The Lariat Trail is a historic scenic road and Denver Mountain Parks corridor whose surviving alignment and infrastructure define the Lookout Mountain landscape.

identificationSites.name: Morrison Stone, Lime & Town Company Quarry and Industrial Town Landscape
identificationSites.category: Quarry / Industrial Company Town / Railroad Landscape
overview: The Morrison Stone, Lime & Town Company quarry shaped an industrial company-town and railroad landscape whose surviving features identify Morrison's stone-working history.

identificationSites.name: Mount Falcon Walker Estate & Summer White House Ruins Complex
identificationSites.location: Mount Falcon Park, Jefferson County, Colorado
identificationSites.category: Estate Ruins / Planned Civic Complex / Historic Landscape
overview: The Walker estate castle ruins and Summer White House foundation identify a planned estate and civic complex preserved within Mount Falcon Park.

identificationSites.name: Platte Canyon DSP&P / Colorado & Southern Railroad Corridor
overview: The Platte Canyon corridor preserves the identity and surviving grade of the Denver, South Park & Pacific and later Colorado & Southern narrow-gauge railroad route.

identificationSites.name: Red Rocks Park & Mount Morrison CCC–WPA Complex
identificationSites.location: Red Rocks Park, Jefferson County, Colorado
identificationSites.category: New Deal Park / CCC Camp / Amphitheatre Complex
overview: Red Rocks Park is a nationally significant New Deal landscape whose amphitheatre, Civilian Conservation Corps camp resources, and park infrastructure identify the broader CCC–WPA complex.

identificationSites.name: Rocky Flats Nuclear Weapons Plant & Cleanup Landscape
identificationSites.category: Cold War Nuclear Weapons / Industrial Archaeology Complex
overview: Rocky Flats was a major Cold War nuclear-weapons production plant; its documented former industrial footprint and cleanup landscape identify the historic complex.

identificationSites.name: Schwartzwalder Mine & Ralston Buttes Uranium Complex
identificationSites.category: Uranium Mine / Mining District / Remediation Complex
overview: The Schwartzwalder Mine anchors the Ralston Buttes uranium complex, identified by its documented production history, mine workings, and remediation landscape.
